Problem Statement:
Write a program to search a target element in a 2D matrix using binary search. 
Input Description:
Each row and each column of the matrix is sorted in ascending order. The first line contains the number of rows and columns. The next lines contain the matrix elements. The last line contains the target element. 
Output Description:
The output is the row and column index of the target or -1 if not found. 
Sample Input:
3 4
1 3 5 7
10 11 16 20
23 30 34 60
3 
Sample Output:
0 1
